description: Feared pirate fleet commanded by Captain Thorn.

timeline.summary: Daphne Vail, lookout of the Ugly Mug, stays silent as the Dire Fleet approaches, then asks Thorn for a promotion and becomes first mate of the Dire.
timeline.quote: Impressed, he made her first mate of the Dire , securing her loyalty forever.

timeline.summary: Thorn leads an expedition into the heart of Ixalan using Flinch's knowledge of the golden city.
timeline.quote: Captain Thorn is using Flinch's piecemeal knowledge of the location of the golden city to lead an expedition into the heart of Ixalan.
